title: veronicastrum axillare
intro: Veronicastrum axillare, commonly known as Chinese foxglove, is a plant species in the borage family (Boraginaceae) native to China and Korea. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to promote digestion, relieve coughs, and reduce inflammation. The health benefits of Veronicastrum axillare include reducing fever and improving respiratory issues due to its expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects.
